message:
fix(ledger): preserve document identity, lifecycle and complete section coverage

Separate copy identity from byte equality, reprocess tombstoned reappearances,
keep converted sources outside Markdown deletion reconciliation, refuse lossy
UTF-8 publication, and remove the presentation cap from sync and legacy recall.
Add production-path regression fixtures; execution remains deferred by the no-build constraint.
